scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Governance tokens vote on parameters, upgrades and treasury.
Delegation lets holders assign votes to representatives.
scenes.vo: Governance tokens vote on parameters, upgrades and treasury. Proposal lifecycle: forum discussion to vote to timelock to execution. Delegation lets holders assign votes to representatives. Risks: low turnout, concentrated voting power, borrowed votes, rushed proposals, weak timelocks.
scenes.cap: Governance tokens vote on parameters, upgrades and treasury. Proposal lifecycle: forum discussion → vote → timelock → execution. Delegation lets holders assign votes to representatives. Risks: low turnout, concentrated voting power, borrowed votes, rushed proposals, weak timelocks.

scenes.sub: A proposal to raise a collateral's LTV passes with 8% turnout, 70% of it from three wallets. Lenders now carry more bad-debt risk, decided by a few voters. Track governance for markets you're in. It changes your risk without you doing anything.
